### PA_MSQ_E1: Select all primary animal tissue types established in histology: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Epithelial Tissue
- [ ] B) Connective Tissue
- [ ] C) Muscular Tissue
- [ ] D) Nervous Tissue
- [ ] E) Vascular Tissue only

> **✅ Answers:** A) Epithelial Tissue, B) Connective Tissue, C) Muscular Tissue, D) Nervous Tissue
> **Explanation:** 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

### PA_MSQ_E2: Select all locations containing Simple Cuboidal Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Thyroid gland follicles
- [ ] B) Salivary gland ducts
- [ ] C) PCT of renal nephron
- [ ] D) Dry skin surface
- [ ] E) Ovary surface

> **✅ Answers:** A) Thyroid gland follicles, B) Salivary gland ducts, C) PCT of renal nephron, E) Ovary surface
> **Explanation:** Simple cuboidal lines thyroid follicles, salivary ducts, renal PCT, ovary surface.

### PA_MSQ_E3: Which components constitute formed blood elements? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Erythrocytes (RBC)
- [ ] B) Leucocytes (WBC)
- [ ] C) Thrombocytes (Platelets)
- [ ] D) Serum Albumin
- [ ] E) Plasma Fibrinogen

> **✅ Answers:** A) Erythrocytes (RBC), B) Leucocytes (WBC), C) Thrombocytes (Platelets)
> **Explanation:** Formed elements = RBC, WBC, Platelets.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which components constitute formed blood" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PA_MSQ_E4: Select all characteristics belonging to Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Voluntary neural control
- [ ] B) Multinucleated syncytium
- [ ] C) Cross-striated banding
- [ ] D) Intercalated Discs
- [ ] E) Subject to fatigue

> **✅ Answers:** A) Voluntary neural control, B) Multinucleated syncytium, C) Cross-striated banding, E) Subject to fatigue
> **Explanation:** Skeletal muscle is voluntary, syncytial, striated, subject to fatigue.

### PA_MSQ_E5: Which anatomical sites feature Hyaline Cartilage covers? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Articular ends of long bones
- [ ] B) Nasal septum
- [ ] C) Costal cartilage of ribs
- [ ] D) Intervertebral discs
- [ ] E) Tracheal rings

> **✅ Answers:** A) Articular ends of long bones, B) Nasal septum, C) Costal cartilage of ribs, E) Tracheal rings
> **Explanation:** Hyaline cartilage lines bone articular ends, nose, ribs, trachea.

### PA_MSQ_E6: Select all anatomical locations lined by Simple Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Endothelium of blood vessels
- [ ] B) Mesothelium of pericardium
- [ ] C) Bowman's capsule parietal layer
- [ ] D) Pulmonary alveoli air sacs
- [ ] E) Skin epidermis

> **✅ Answers:** A) Endothelium of blood vessels, B) Mesothelium of pericardium, C) Bowman's capsule parietal layer, D) Pulmonary alveoli air sacs
> **Explanation:** Simple squamous lines blood vessel endothelium, mesothelium, Bowman's capsule, and lung alveoli.

### PA_MSQ_E7: Select all functions performed by Epithelial Tissue sheets: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Physical protection
- [ ] B) Selective absorption
- [ ] C) Glandular secretion
- [ ] D) Sensory perception
- [ ] E) High-voltage action potential conduction

> **✅ Answers:** A) Physical protection, B) Selective absorption, C) Glandular secretion, D) Sensory perception
> **Explanation:** Epithelium protects, absorbs, secretes, and perceives sensations.

### PA_MSQ_E8: Which features characterize Yellow Elastic Connective Tissue? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Branching yellow elastin fibers
- [ ] B) High elasticity and recoil capacity
- [ ] C) Found in walls of large elastic arteries
- [ ] D) Present in vocal cords
- [ ] E) Inelastic thick white collagen bundles

> **✅ Answers:** A) Branching yellow elastin fibers, B) High elasticity and recoil capacity, C) Found in walls of large elastic arteries, D) Present in vocal cords
> **Explanation:** Elastic CT contains branching elastin fibers giving high elasticity to arteries and vocal cords.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which features characterize Yellow Elast" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PA_MSQ_E9: Select all cell types present in nervous tissue organ structures: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Excitable Neurones
- [ ] B) Support Neuroglia
- [ ] C) Ependymal lining cells
- [ ] D) Schwann myelinating cells
- [ ] E) Mineralized Osteocytes

> **✅ Answers:** A) Excitable Neurones, B) Support Neuroglia, C) Ependymal lining cells, D) Schwann myelinating cells
> **Explanation:** Nervous tissue comprises neurones and various neuroglial support cells.

### PA_MSQ_E10: Which formed blood elements lack a nucleus at mature functional stage? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Mature Human Erythrocytes (RBC)
- [ ] B) Blood Thrombocytes (Platelets)
- [ ] C) Monocytes
- [ ] D) Lymphocytes
- [ ] E) Neutrophils

> **✅ Answers:** A) Mature Human Erythrocytes (RBC), B) Blood Thrombocytes (Platelets)
> **Explanation:** Human RBCs and Platelets are non-nucleated in mature peripheral circulation.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which formed blood elements lack a nucle" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>
